data.memory_usage_summary: The Facade-based Monolith Splitting memory reinforced the existing thin-coordinator pattern in the PR; remediation kept the facade boundaries intact while removing invalid v8-ignores and adding unit tests for the extracted sibling modules without rewriting the existing facade tests.
data.summary:
* Removed misapplied `ts-type` v8-ignore on `pickCompletionAgentType` (lifecycle.ts) — all 8 if/else branches already covered by tests
  * Removed both misapplied `upstream` v8-ignores in `webhook-callbacks.ts` and added unit tests for `review`/`remediation`/`pull_request` agentData branches plus `'used'`/`'not_used'` and empty-`gh_pr_url`/missing-`linearIssueId` paths so v8 sees every branch
  * Replaced circular constant-mirror assertions in `retry-logic.test.ts` with relationship invariants (warning < kill, warning gap ≥ check interval, inactivity < kill, image-pull > container-create, positivity, integer/range)
  * Split monolithic `describeAgent` test into `it.each` cases plus a dedicated unknown-label fallback test; reset all `mockLogger` spy state in a top-level `beforeEach` to prevent leakage across describe blocks
  * `pnpm run ci:tracked` green locally, all GitHub Actions checks passing on commit `8382716f2`; out-of-scope DoD gaps from the review body (mandatory unit tests for `dispatchTask`/`markTaskCompleted`/`streamTaskLogs`/`notifyCompletion`/`scheduleRetry` and the <300-line target) deferred per the PR description
